title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-464 HLS_tmp Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-464 NAS devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the HLS_tmp parameter provided to the share.cgi endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create or modify files in the context of admin.
